sources.quote: the projection from scene state to image pixels is many-to-one
we record raw RGB camera frames from real indoor rooms using a calibrated monocular camera
a separate LiDAR sensor measuring ground-truth depth maps
a frozen external vision backbone that was previously pretrained on synthetic 3D point-tracking datasets

ops.name: monocular_camera_projection
ops.quote: collapses multiple combinations of surface reflectance and ambient lighting into identical pixel values

ops.name: pure_2d_loss
ops.quote: optimizes a purely 2D patch-matching loss objective with no depth supervision

ops.name: train_regime_a
ops.quote: the encoder ingests only the raw RGB camera frames and optimizes a purely 2D patch-matching loss objective

ops.name: train_regime_b
ops.quote: we attach a frozen external vision backbone that was previously pretrained on synthetic 3D point-tracking datasets

ops.name: loss_with_lidar_depth
ops.quote: we feed the LiDAR ground-truth depth maps directly into the training loss as auxiliary supervision

ops.name: train_regime_c
ops.quote: we feed the LiDAR ground-truth depth maps directly into the training loss as auxiliary supervision

claims.statement: Under Regime A, 3D geometry arises without 3D prediction targets in the training loss.

claims.statement: Under Regime B, 3D geometry emerges purely from 2D relational learning without 3D prediction targets.
